service.en: Issue a family residency visa (investor or partner sponsor)
service.ar: إصدار تأشيرة إقامة عائلية (كفيل مستثمر أو شريك)
service.ur: فیملی ریزیڈنسی ویزا کا اجرا (سرمایہ کار یا شراکت دار کفیل)

about: A resident sponsor who is an investor or partner requests a residency visa for a family member.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Resident sponsor who is an investor or partner
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
